Rule Name: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in react-router
Rule Description: Affected versions of react-router and turbo-stream are vulnerable to Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling. React Router Framework Mode uses turbo-stream to serialize loader/action data into Single Fetch responses. The underlying serialization algorithm becomes a bottleneck on certain data shapes, so an attacker who can influence the serialized data can cause excessive resource consumption and a Denial of Service.
Affected versions of @remix-run/server-runtime and react-router are vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) / Origin Validation Error.
Affected versions of mcp-server-semgrep are vulnerable to Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection').
Affected versions of react-router are vulnerable to URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect').
Affected versions of react-router are vulnerable to Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting').
Affected versions of @hono/node-server are vulnerable to Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal').
